profiles_intro: Save birth details for yourself and the people you care about, then fill any calculator in one tap. Only you can see them.
profiles_delete_body: The profile is deleted right away and can’t be restored. Reports you already have stay as they are.
profiles_footnote: Deleting a profile doesn’t affect existing reports; deleting your account deletes all profiles. Birth details never go into share links, analytics or AI chats.
profiles_empty_body: Save birth details for yourself and the people you care about, then fill any calculator in one tap.
profiles_limit_body: You’ve reached the limit of {max} profiles. Delete one you no longer need first.
profiles_self_exists: Only one profile can be marked as “Me”.
profiles_not_found: This profile no longer exists. Please reload the page.
profiles_error_generic: That didn’t go through. Please try again later.
profiles_field_full_name: Full birth name (optional, for name numbers)
profiles_field_default: Make this the default profile (used on your Today panel)
profiles_pick_error: Couldn’t load your profiles. Please try again later.
profiles_missing_gender: This profile has no gender. Please choose one.
profiles_missing_location: This profile has no birthplace. Please choose one.
profiles_missing_time: Zi Wei needs a birth time, and this profile doesn’t have one. Please add it.
profiles_missing_birth_date: This profile uses a lunar date. Please enter the Gregorian date of birth.
profiles_save_desc: Save what you entered as a profile so you can fill it in one tap next time.
profiles_save_incomplete: Fill in the birth details first, then save them as a profile.
